test_run_eval_mmlu: run the eval module with --eval-name mmlu --port 30000 --num-examples 10 to evaluate a model on MMLU
test_run_eval_gsm8k: run the eval module with --eval-name gsm8k --port 30000 --num-examples 10 to evaluate a model on GSM8K
test_run_eval_math: run the eval module with --eval-name math --port 30000 --num-examples 10 to evaluate a model on the math benchmark
run_run_eval_once: run a single evaluation using run_eval_once with args, base_url, and an Eval sampler object
test_run_eval_repeat: run the eval module with --repeat 3 to repeat the evaluation three times and report mean score and latency
